GENERAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS FOR SUBMITTING AN APPLICATION FOR PARTICIPATION IN THE PRELIMINARY STAGE OF THE "EUROVISION 2025" INTERNATIONAL SONG CONTEST ("DEPI EVRATESIL 2025") By submitting your Application for Participation, you hereby agree to the terms and conditions of the Application, as well as the general terms and conditions outlined below ("General Provisions and Conditions”).
The terms "Television Company," "We," "Our," and "Us" hereinafter refer to the "Public Television Company of Armenia" CJSC.
1. GENERAL TERMS 1.1.
These General Terms and Conditions apply to your application for participation in the Project and are an integral part of the Application for Participation.
1.2. You are responsible for any and all expenses related to completing the Application for Participation (e.g., phone calls, postal services, internet services, creation of the submitted song and lyrics, arrangement, recording, and, in case of advancing to the final (televised) round of the preliminary competition, costs associated with stage performance, costumes, dancers, and other necessary expenses, including travel, transportation, accommodation fees, insurance, taxes, and other charges).We are not responsible for your personal expenses.
1.3. You agree that your Application will not be considered if it is incomplete, unclear, incorrectly submitted or addressed, lost, damaged during electronic transmission, or submitted after the specified deadline.
1.4. You confirm that you have read the following requirements for participating in the Project and agree to them:
a) Applications are accepted until January 10, 2025.
b) Participation in the Project is free.
c) Citizens and residents of Armenia, and ethnic Armenians worldwide, who are at least 16 years old as of May 13, 2025, are eligible.
d) Participation is allowed only with a ready song.
In case of winning, the participant will represent Armenia at the Eurovision Song Contest 2025 with their submitted song.
e) The submitted song (music and lyrics) for the contest must not have been released in any form before September 1, 2024.
This means that the song must not have been released or made available on the internet, online music platforms, television, or radio broadcasts, nor performed or played at concerts or various events before the specified date.
f)The song submitted to the contest must be complete and final, including music, lyrics, and arrangement.
g) The maximum duration of the submitted song to the contest is 3 minutes.
The lyrics may be in Armenian, English, or any other language.
h) Participation in the contest can be individual, as a duo, or as a band (up to six members).
In any case, only one application is required.
i)The application for participation must be submitted only once.
Participation in the auditions is allowed only once.
j)Personal information must match the details on your identification document.
If the personal data you submitted does not match the data on the identification document, your application will not be considered.
k) You must attach your photos (at least one photo) and the song submitted to the contest (in MP3 or WAV format) at the end of the application.
l)You must also attach a copyright registration certificate for the submitted song to the application.
m) If you win, the submitted song may be modified or reworked at the Public TV Company's complete discretion.
1.5. You acknowledge that due to the high number of applications, we will not confirm or respond to all the applications with the exception of those selected for the next round.
We will review your Application for Participation and determine which applicants meet the requirements for the next selection round.
You acknowledge and agree that participants are selected solely at our discretion and that these decisions are final and not subject to appeal.
2. YOUR OBLIGATIONS 2.1.
You are obliged to follow the rules and regulations of the Project, which will be communicated to you either in writing or verbally.
You acknowledge that we may, at our absolute discretion, amend, modify, or revise these rules and regulations at any time.
2.2. You agree to participate in auditions and selection rounds upon our request, and we will notify you of the dates.
We reserve the right to change, extend, suspend, or terminate any stage of the selection process and/or the Project at any time, including structural or content-related aspects, at our sole discretion.
2.3. You guarantee that you meet all the requirements for the audition stage and participation in the Project and agree to provide us with the necessary supporting documents upon request.
Additionally, you agree to provide all necessary consents and support to obtain any information required to verify the details included in your Application for Participation.
2.4. You agree that from the moment you submit your Application for Participation until the final results of the audition stage are announced and the televised version of the Project concludes, you will not apply for or participate in other auditions or appear in any radio or television (visual) programs, including other music projects ("Other Projects"), without our prior written consent.
If you are asked to apply for or participate in other auditions or appear in other projects, you are obligated to inform us immediately and may participate only after receiving our written consent.
2.5. If you win in the preliminary stage, you are obliged to sign a participation agreement and/or contract ("Participant Agreement") outlining, without limitation, the terms and conditions of your participation in the Contest.
2.6. If, for any reason, you fail to sign the Participant Agreement, you acknowledge that you will not be entitled to continue your participation in the Contest, and we reserve the right to remove and replace you with another participant, as well as seek compensation for any damages incurred, if applicable.
2.7. You agree to provide complete information regarding:
a) Any recording, collaboration, production, and/or other music-related contracts ("Creative Contracts") you have previously signed or are currently under.
b) Any other agreements (written or verbal) with third parties that could hinder your participation in the Project or otherwise obligate you to compensate third parties in connection with your activities in the entertainment industry and/or within the framework of the Project.
If you fail to inform us of the existence of such Creative Contracts and/or other agreements, we reserve the right to remove you from the Project at any time.
2.7.1. By this, you declare and guarantee that you are not a party to any recording, collaboration, production, vocal, or other similar specialized center/school/professional contracts or any other music- related agreements (current or otherwise).
If this is not the case, you hereby authorize us to review any such prior agreements.
2.8. If we determine that any of your Creative or other agreements are in conflict with the General Terms and Conditions or otherwise hinder your participation in the Project and the signing of the Participant Agreement ("Conflict"), we will discuss this Conflict with you.
If we conclude that the Creative or other agreement obstruct your participation in the Project, we reserve the right to remove you from the Project at our absolute discretion.
2.9. You guarantee that nothing in your Application for Participation:
2.9.1. Violates any third party’s copyright or any other rights, 2.9.2.
Damages, in any way, our or any third party’s reputation.
2.10. You agree that we have the right to disqualify you at any stage of the Project’s auditions, selection process, or the Project itself if:
2.10.1. You have provided or provide false, incomplete, inaccurate, or misleading information and/or have misled us in any way, particularly but not limited to your identity, age eligibility, or involvement in any current or previous recording, collaboration, production, vocal, or similar contracts or specialized centers/schools/professionals or being a party to any other music contract (current and prior) 2.10.2.
You fail to meet the eligibility requirements.
2.11. You agree that the winner of the preliminary stage will be determined by a panel of professionals invited and approved by the broadcaster and through public voting, in a ratio determined by the broadcaster.
The decision is final and not subject to appeal.
3. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS 3.1.
If you are invited to participate in the preliminary stage or any subsequent phase of the Project, you consent and authorize us to record and film you, your voice, the submitted song, interviews, and any musical performance presented during or in connection with your application to the Project ("Contribution").
We may use your Contribution in whole, in part, or not at all in connection with the Project.
3.2. You agree that any photos, videos, or other materials submitted as part of your application to the Project and/or as part of your Contribution ("Provided Materials") may be used in the Project.
You guarantee that you have all necessary licenses, rights, agreements and permissions to grant us the right to use the Provided Materials in whole or in part.
4. CONFIDENTIALITY 4.1.
You are obligated to keep confidential and not disclose or release to any person, media outlet, website, or social media platform (including but not limited to YouTube, Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, TikTok, etc.) any information, photos, or other materials related to your Application for Participation, the Project, your or other individuals’ potential involvement, or the Project itself, without our prior written consent, except in cases where the information has already become public (but not as a result of your violation of this clause).
5. OTHER PROVISIONS 5.1.
We reserve the right, at our absolute discretion, to amend, modify, or revise the General Terms and Conditions at any time.
5.2. Any decision made by us as a result of a dispute related to your participation in the Project is final.
